content: As I delve into the world of sales research, one key takeaway that stands out is the importance of **orchestration** in sales. Top performers don't just sell, they orchestrate with AI to close deals. By leveraging AI-powered enablement capabilities, revenue teams can operationalize AI at scale, personalizing sales plays for different roles and industries. This strategic approach can lead to increased efficiency and effectiveness in sales conversations. #sales #salesresearch #AIinSales #SalesEnablement
